{{Otheruses|Boss}}
[[File:Boss_nass.png|thumb|200px|Rugor Nass held the title Boss during the Invasion of Naboo.]]
{{Quote|We're with you, Boss!|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 6">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref>}}
'''Boss''' was the title given to the leader of a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] community. Assisted by the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Rep Council]], the Boss of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] was the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], Head of Government and civilian [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]] of their [[Gungan society|society]].

''Boss'' was also a rank of the [[Reborn]]. Bosses wore black and red robes. They were a combination of all the different Reborn divisions. They were the second highest level, an elite of the organization. Capable of using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] adeptly and able to counter a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] skills; they were [[Desann]]'s best men along with [[Galak Fyyar]]'s [[Shadowtrooper]]s.

[[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]] pilots sometimes addressed their [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] as "Boss."
